note: RFC 4271 Section 9.2 requires not advertising a single route that does not fit within the maximum UPDATE message size. TestRFC4271OversizeSingleRouteNotAdvertised and TestRFC4271FittingRouteIsAdvertised prove message.Splitter.Split returns an error with zero emissions when a single route's attributes exceed the ceiling and emits once with exact attributes/NLRI when it fits. TestRFC4271RelayedRouteTooLargeForThePeerIsWithheld drives reactor.buildFwdBody with valid RFC 4271/1997 attributes: 900 communities (<=4096B) relay byte-identically (ok=true), while 1100 communities (>4096B) return ok=false with empty rawBodies and updates.
